pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex polygonal regions with highly irregular, serrated edge gradients. The dark brown patches exhibit sharp, angular transitions at the margins, creating a stellate or star-burst visual effect across the neck and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected web of light cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial (Y-intersections) with occasional quadri-radial nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively consistent but shows increased frequency and narrowing toward the posterior flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette. Individual fiber clusters create a dense, brush-like textural profile against the background.
